release_date_definition: First public availability of the identified model version, including API or app previews; not a checkpoint, upload, evaluation, or later weights-release date. Null means the archived model version cannot be identified.
model_type_definition: open means downloadable model weights under the publisher's license as of verified_on; it does not imply an OSI-approved license. closed means proprietary hosted access without published weights for this model version.

Claude Sonnet 5.5.notes: Anthropic's September 28 release; evaluated model ID claude-sonnet-5-5.

Yutori n2.notes: Publisher's August 26 launch announces Navigator n2 through the Yutori API. Archived response.model is n2; the evaluated GUI-only SDK configuration disables bash/read/write/edit. Sources checked September 19, 2026.

Claude Opus 5.notes: Proprietary Claude model, available through Anthropic and hosted partners.

Claude Sonnet 5.notes: Proprietary Claude model, available through Anthropic and hosted partners.

GLM-5V Turbo.notes: The publisher's release notes date this API model April 1; the GLM-V repository posted its announcement April 2. GLM-5V-Turbo is not one of the downloadable GLM-V models; the GLM family name does not establish open weights.

GPT-5.6 Luna.notes: OpenAI's July 9, 2026 changelog announces public availability of GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna. The legacy June 26 date is not the public release date. Proprietary hosted model.

GPT-5.6 Sol.notes: OpenAI's July 9, 2026 changelog announces public availability of GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna. The legacy June 26 date is not the public release date. Proprietary hosted model.

GPT-6 Astra.notes: OpenAI's September 3, 2026 changelog announces GPT-6 Astra. Proprietary hosted model.

Gemini 3 Flash Preview.notes: gemini-3-flash-preview; the legacy aggregate shortens the same model name to Gemini 3 Flash. Proprietary Gemini API model, not the open-weight Gemma family.

Gemini 3.6 Flash.notes: Proprietary Gemini API model. Metadata is retained even though its incomplete evaluation is excluded.

Kimi K3.notes: Public model launch July 16; downloadable weights followed later. API use in the evaluation does not make this a closed-weight model.

Meta Muse Spark.notes: Version unverified. The unversioned archived run svc_16_409b44 records only the rolling provider alias super_nova_ext, not a Muse Spark version. Neither the family's April 8 launch nor the legacy August 5 date identifies the evaluated version; do not place this run on the release-date curve. The unversioned legacy aggregate likewise does not pin a version.

Meta Muse Spark 1.1.notes: Proprietary Muse Spark model served through Meta Model API; not an open-weight Llama or Muse Glimmer release.

Meta Muse Spark 1.2.notes: Proprietary model available through Muse Code and Meta Model API.

Meta Muse Spark 1.3.notes: Proprietary model available through Muse Code and Meta Model API.

MiniMax M3.notes: Public model launch June 1; downloadable weights followed later under the MiniMax Community License. The hyphenated legacy label identifies the same model.

Qwen3.5-9B-Thinking.notes: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B with thinking enabled; the legacy VL name describes this multimodal model, not a separate release. Official news announces availability March 2. February 27 is a pre-release repository upload date. Apache-2.0 weights.
